blocks.text: ZDX GraphQL API uses the following response codes and error messages.

table: Verify and correct the credentials. Do not retry.
Refresh the token and retry once.
Insufficient permissions to access the resource.
Do not retry. Verify your assigned user role.
The OAuth scope required for this request is missing.
Do not retry. Reissue the token with the correct scope.
Invalid GraphQL request, or request body exceeds the 100 KiB limit.
Verify and correct the request structure. Do not retry.
Invalid argument, request content type, or request content encoding.
Verify and correct the request parameters. Do not retry.
A required query argument or selection field is missing.
Verify and correct the query structure. Do not retry.
Business validation logic or constraints failed.
Verify input values and parameters and correct them if needed. Do not retry.
Resolve the conflicting state before retrying.
The mandatory Accept-Encoding: gzip header is missing.
Add the header to your request. Do not retry without it.
The requested resource does not exist.
Verify the resource identifier. Do not retry.
The requested data is still processing.
A required prerequisite state has not been met.
Do not retry until the prerequisite state is updated.
API rate limits have been exceeded.
Retry using exponential backoff and honor the Retry-After header.
Retry with backoff. Escalate to Zscaler Support with the x-request-id if persistent.
An upstream dependency or service is temporarily unavailable.
Retry with backoff. Escalate to Zscaler Support with the x-request-id if persistent.
Request timed out or an internal service dependency failed.
Retry with backoff. Escalate to Zscaler Support with the x-request-id if persistent.

blocks.text: For requests returning DATA_NOT_READY, RESOURCE_LOCKED, RATE_LIMITED, RETRY_LATER, or any 5xx server error, retry the operation using exponential backoff. Treat all other error codes as client-side configuration errors. Do not retry these requests to prevent exceeding your daily consumption rate limit budget.
